title: cse-coach showcase per-problem contract
description: dashboard/showcase/<lcNumber>.json: the entries of showcase.json that share one lcNumber, each unchanged, emitted by scripts/export_showcase.py (via scripts/dashboard_indexes.py). Its entry shape is showcase.schema.json's `entry`, referenced by that schema's $id, so the two cannot drift. schemaVersion and generatedAt are copied from showcase.json.
